//: Write a draft, then loop: a reviewer approves or sends feedback, and the writer revises in its own conversation. Stops at APPROVED or after 3 reviews.
name: review_loop
description: Writer / reviewer loop with a route inside the loop body and a shared writer history.

nodes.name: write
nodes.system_prompt: You are a concise technical writer. Write at most five sentences.

nodes.name: reviewer
nodes.system_prompt: You review drafts. Reply with exactly APPROVED if the draft is clear and correct; otherwise give at most three short bullet points of feedback.

nodes.name: revise
nodes.system_prompt: You are a concise technical writer. Rewrite your previous draft, applying the reviewer's feedback. Reply with the new draft only.
